label_freeze: Revision 2: all titles, candidate IDs and URLs neutralized and partial-support labels pre-reviewed before any lexical or embedding measurement on 2026-10-24.
label_authoring: Separate agent from runtime/ranking implementation; manually authored description-level labels. Not an external annotator or real inventory audit.

relevance_scale.1: Explicit support for at least one requested facility or condition, with an essential qualifier or another requirement unstated. Generic descriptions or a different species/modality alone do not count.
relevance_scale.2: Explicit textual support for all queried lodging requirements; never a real inventory guarantee.

split_policy: First 24 source-wish groups are dev. Remaining 20 source-wish groups and four no-answer controls are held-out test. No wish ID crosses splits. Labels frozen before model measurement.

measurement_policy.candidate_scope: Use title + text/content only for scoring; labels, ground, wrong_city, contradiction, expected_relevant_ids and theme must never enter ranker input.
measurement_policy.primary: macro nDCG@3, gains 0/1/3 for relevance 0/1/2; report split separately; skip all-zero cases with explicit count.
measurement_policy.no_answer: No-answer cases measure whether a ranker falsely claims an answer; ordering alone cannot establish abstention. Report them separately and do not threshold-tune on held-out labels.
ablations: hybrid lexical + embedding with the same filters
unfiltered embedding diagnostic for geography risk, never runtime
measurement_policy.constraints: Similarity must not set confirmed/passed/available or interpret a label as provider confirmation. Keep identical candidate pools, prefilters and deterministic tie breaks across scored methods.
